description:
Give test support one derivation of the shipped item-kind declarations from the default profile package.

## Background

The shipped item kinds are the `[[contribution]] target = "item-kinds"` section of `profiles/jit-default/manifest.toml`. Tests restate them by hand in four places and the `D-[0-9]+` id pattern 14 times. `@/inv/domain-agnostic` keeps package vocabulary out of engine code, so the derivation belongs to test support.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Shared test support exposes the shipped item-kind declarations as read from the default package's item-kinds contribution, in the TOML and typed forms tests consume, with no restated kind, alias, mode or id pattern.
- [hard] REQ-02: A unit test proves that a change to the package's contribution changes the derivation's output.
title: Shared test support derives shipped item kinds from the default package
